Class ResearchProject

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.ResearchProject
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ResearchProject extends Object implements Serializable
A long-running research effort with a topic, participants, and the papers that came out of it. Non-researchers cannot join.
